Name: Quest Time Limits - Continued
Author: FlyingTNT
Description:
This is a continuation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16403]Quest Time Limits[/url] by aedenthorn.

By default this mod multiplies the days left for new daily quests and special orders by 2. You can set custom multipliers for each in the config.

Multipliers only affect new quests and special orders. For daily quests, "days left" is set when you accept the quest. For special orders (including Qi special orders), the due date that the board displays is set at the beginning of the week regardless of when / if they are accepted or you even have the special orders boards unlocked. However, the actual due date will be set when you choose the order.

If you set a multiplier to zero or less than zero, quests will never expire. At end of each day "days left" will not be decremented for daily quests and "due date" will be reset to the original value for special order quests.


[size=5]Config
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5]Technical[/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Source code: [url=https://github.com/FlyingTNT/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/FlyingTNT/StardewValleyMods[/url].
